lina: starting a canary for zephyr-lite-int8 on /tools/structured after qconfig tweak; parse errors jumped to ~4.9% on onboarding set

lina: failing sample:
```
FYI: model thinks this field is optional
{"intent": "update_profile", "user_id": "u123", "attrs": [
  "email:\"x@ex.com\"",
], } trailing note about confidence
```

josiah: common problems: leading explanatory lines, trailing commas, mid-stream commentary. json.loads dies.

ben: propose lightweight repair harness toggled per canary:
1) strip-leading-prefixes (drop lines like `FYI:` until first `{`)
2) token-split rejoin heuristics for cut words
3) tolerant parse (json5-like) then reserialize strict JSON
4) chunked-append repair: if starts with `{` but missing `}`, append up to 3 braces and retry
5) final fallback: wrap as {"__raw": "..."} and mark as wrapped

sophia: repaired JSON must still validate; if validation fails, tag `repair.validated=false` and do not autopromote. telemetry keys: `repair.attempted`, `repair.method`, `repair.success`, `repair.validation`, `repair.kind`.

lina: canary snapshot (30m): canary_count=1200, parse_fail_rate=0.049, repair_attempted=220, repair_success=95

deploy-bot: start-canary zephyr-lite-int8 job=11234 logs=https://ci/canary/11234

josiah: tiny local prototype (strip prefixes + json5):
```bash
cat sample_output.txt | awk '/\{/{p=1} p{print}' | node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'); try{console.log(JSON.stringify(require('json5').parse(s)))}catch(e){console.error('parse fail') ; process.exit(2)}"
```

ben: chunked-append must only run when imbalance is small and no unmatched-quote heuristics trigger to avoid false positives. will add `repair.suspect` if keys differ structurally from expected.

sophia: policy: do not enable auto-repair for Dedicated orgs by default; org-level opt-in only. rollback if user-visible contract errors > 0.1% for 1h.

lina: plan: run A/B for 4h comparing repair_mode=prettyparse vs repair_mode=chunked-append. collect parse_fail_rate, repair_attempted, repair_success_rate, downstream_contract_errors.

josiah: I'll add unit tests for trailing-commas, leading-prefixes, token-splits, truncated-append and a small fuzz harness simulating quant-noise.

ben: I'll add telemetry fields `repair.kind`, `repair.confidence` (0.0-1.0), and `repair.suspect`.

deploy-bot: canary 11234 status: pods running, sampler active.

lina: follow-ups: josiah tests+harness, ben telemetry+heuristics, sophia policy toggle+rollback docs, i'll run AB and report after 4h. :clock4:
